guides.favoredWhen: Even. She dodges with E and waits in shroud, so time your E on her E-down.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: the E-dodge war decides it.
She hides behind minions at 1: Q the wave to reach her.
She E-dodges your E: E where her dash ends.

tips.text: Her E2-plus-passive-plus-shroud is the full answer: never chase into the shroud.
Dodge her Q2: the second blast is the damage.
She waits in shroud: time your W stun where she reappears.
Her E2 interrupts dashes: E in, walk out, never E back blind.
Shroud read plus E-dodge won: the Akali who never hides never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Even skill lane. Vary your E timing to bait Charm, and never E onto Bramble or Ignite.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: your E timing against her Charm decides it.
She tracks your E above all: vary every dash.
She holds Charm through your first E and for your backline dives: bait it, never feed it.

tips.text: E in, wait out her W speed, then proc the passive: patience lands the third hit.
Do not Q wave and face for free: she punishes Qs with push.
A connecting W stun means no fear of Charm: stun first, commit after.
After 6, watch R-E forward plus Ignite: clone placement decides the all-in.
E varied plus clone placed: the Ahri who never Charms you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She bullies all lane and holds E for your engage. Bait the stun, then go.

keyTips.text: She bullies all lane: respect levels, take windows.
She never wastes the stun: bait E before engaging.
Run Hail of Blades: she plays safe at 1 against your dash.

tips.text: Weather the bully: your windows open after hers close.
Q poke from range: E2 is for engages, not trades.
Her R cannot undo your R: rewind every committed combo.
Engage when E is spent: no scatter means no answer.
E baited plus R held: the Syndra who never stuns you never wins.

sources.author: Trisend3
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (title and profile badge) · Syndra main

guides.favoredWhen: Even. He plays around your passive procs, so vary the engage, hold R, and punish spent shadows.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: he plays around your passive procs.
He answers your E-Q-in with backwards WEQ: vary the engage angle.
He Ignites early to cut your R heal: respect the all-in after 6.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Take Hail of Blades and E in early: he respects the HoB opener.
Proc passive for free when he lets you: unanswered E-Qs stack up.
His W is the answer tool: engage when shadows are spent.
R heals through his combo: save R for the turn, not the engage.
Death Mark lands him behind you: E away from the exit when he ults.
Procs landed plus R held: the Zed who never zones you never wins.

keyTips.text: Start Raptors with Q at level 1 and have mid ward enemy Raptors to expose an invade angle.
After Scuttle, check the two nearest lanes for ganks, often pressing mid, then cycle back to Raptors and Krugs.
Commit to major fights with Chronobreak ready, since it escapes and re-enters after risky plays.

tips.text: Skill W at level 2 and clear Krugs with Smite plus Red, then take E at level 3 ahead of Wolves, Gromp, Blue, and Scuttle.
Favor volatile lanes or reliable setup for ganks; never force an invade without nearby priority, pings, and a read on the enemy jungler.
Value early takedowns and Void Grubs over an early Dragon, bending the trade to lane state and contest strength.
Target these item timings: first finished item near 9 to 10 minutes, second near 14 to 16, third near 19 to 20.
Default back to Raptors and Krugs with no confident play, protecting the fast income curve into core items.
Invade only when nearby lanes move first and the enemy jungler spot stays known or findable.
Before objective fights, verify enemy positions, health, vision, and summoners, preferring fights where the map favors Ekko.
Initiate as needed when the ultimate banks a safe exit, but guard the lead and finished items over low-value trades.
Turn an early resource lead into picks and map pressure through assassin threat and strong scaling.
Hunt isolated or vulnerable targets in ganks and skirmishes, skipping long fights where lockdown sticks without the ultimate ready.
Set the ultimate return point as the safety plan before risky entries instead of relying on it after getting trapped.
Convert each kill or forced recall into camp access, a neutral objective, or vision toward faster item completion.

itemization.text: Run Dark Harvest with Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, and Treasure Hunter, plus Magical Footwear and Cosmic Insight with attack-speed, adaptive-force, and health shards.
Build Nashor's Tooth into Lich Bane and Rabadon's Deathcap on one core path, with Sorcerer's Shoes and Mejai's Soulstealer as options.
Use Dusk and Dawn with Shadowflame, or Nashor's Tooth into Dusk and Dawn plus Rabadon's Deathcap, as other paths.
Pick situationally from Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass, Banshee's Veil, Cosmic Drive, Mercury's Treads, and Plated Steelcaps against the threats actually reaching Ekko.

keyTips.text: Accept a weak early lane built on surviving to scale rather than forcing every trade.
Slow-push the first two or three waves, then crash hard on wave three or four for a recall tempo edge.
Treat the W stun as a major teamfight tool by predicting movement; even a miss still banks the shield on entry.

tips.text: Pick a wave plan early: shove, concede the push, or line up a cheater recall.
Sync wave and reset timing with the jungler route to support their next play.
Roam freely once one Q clears casters around level 7 or 9 without donating the whole wave.
Trade fast with E1, Q, E2, auto; a missed Q makes triggering the passive much harder.
Shield the exit or stun for a kill with E1, W, E2, Q, auto.
Point roams and resources at the teammate or lane carrying the win condition.
With bot already ahead, hunt dives and counterplays that stretch its lead.
Arrive early to fights and build plays with the jungler.
Farm sides for picks, slow-pushing first so opponents must answer while the play starts.
Check bushes with W for free vision instead of face-checking.
Smooth the cast with E1 into W, which hides part of the throw animation.
Hold R for the most valuable ultimate instead of spending it on the first forced mistake, using W cover and passive footwork to wait.
Respect crowd control as the main vulnerability on an otherwise bursty scaler.
Run E1, Q, E2 for a faster, longer combo at the cost of Q reliability over E1, E2, Q.
With situational Hextech Rocketbelt, burst E1, Q, E2, Rocketbelt, auto.

itemization.text: Run Hail of Blades with Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, and Relentless Hunter, plus Manaflow Band and Scorch.
Take Flash and Teleport as the defensive mid summoners.
Build Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, and Dusk and Dawn.
Start Doran's Ring, buying Dark Seal, Blasting Wand, Aether Wisp, and Sheen early.
Rotate situationally through Mejai's Soulstealer, Zhonya's Hourglass, Shadowflame, Banshee's Veil, Morellonomicon, and Hextech Rocketbelt.
